---
title: Section Anchor Links
---

## Overview

In HTML pages that use a Bootstrap theme (the default), hovering over a
section heading shows a link icon next to it. Click it to jump to that
section, or copy its address to share a link to it.

The icon is added to headings from level 2 to level 6, to numbered figures
(`#fig-…`) and to numbered tables (`#tbl-…`). The page title is not
included.

## Turning it off

Set `anchor-sections` to `false`, for one document or for the whole project:

``` yaml
format:
  html:
    anchor-sections: false
```

To leave a single heading out, give it the `no-anchor` class:

``` markdown
## Internal notes {.no-anchor}
```

## Differences from Quarto 1

- Pages that don't use a Bootstrap theme (`theme: none` or `minimal: true`)
  get no anchor links yet.
- `q2 preview` does not show them yet; `q2 render` does.
